typography.strategy: High contrast, geometric for headings to give a cinematic modern vibe. Legible, clean sans for the body text to ensure readability on small screens and at 10-foot TV distances.

layouts.general: Mobile-first responsive. Dark theme exclusively. Cinematic and immersive.
layouts.hero: Edge-to-edge carousel. 80vh height on mobile. `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#050505] via-[#050505]/50 to-transparent` overlay.
layouts.content_rows: Horizontal scroll containers. `flex overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory gap-4 px-4 pb-4`. Use `scrollbar-hide` utility.
layouts.grid: Used for 'All Movies' or 'All Series'. `grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-4`.
layouts.tv_optimization: Large touch targets (`min-h-[48px]`). Elements MUST have explicit `focus:` states for Android TV D-pad navigation.

components.login_screen: Cinematic background (blurred movie poster). Central glassmorphic card (`bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`). Native-feeling inputs.
components.movie_poster: Aspect ratio 2:3. `rounded-xl`. Image object-cover. Must include focus/hover scaling.
components.live_tv_card: Aspect ratio 16:9 for channel thumbnails. `rounded-lg`. Overlay with channel logo/name.
components.category_chips: Pill-shaped `rounded-full px-6 py-2`. Default `bg-[#14141E] text-white/70`, Active `bg-white text-black font-bold`.
components.video_player: Full screen absolute layout. Custom controls overlay `bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 to-transparent`. Large intuitive play/pause icons.
components.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom. Glassmorphism `bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10`. Only visible on mobile/tablets, convert to sidebar on TV/Desktop.

motion.interactions: All interactive elements (posters, buttons, chips) MUST have `transition-transform duration-300 ease-out`.
motion.focus: CRITICAL for Google TV: `focus:scale-105 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-white/80 focus:outline-none focus:z-10`

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient shadow or gradient backdrop.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-form-submit-button"`, `data-testid="movie-poster-card"`).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use modern, sweeping edge-to-edge layouts.
Do not use `transition: all`. Specify properties e.g., `transition-transform duration-300 ease-out`.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to EVERY interactive element.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds under text. Always use a solid color or glassmorphism (e.g., bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md).
Hide scrollbars on horizontal lists using custom CSS (`::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }`).
Do not invent placeholder image URLs; use the provided image URLs.
Create dynamic, immersive hero sections with heavy gradient overlays (e.g., from-black to-transparent) to make text readable.
Write `.js` or `.jsx` components. Do not use `.tsx` as per the environment rules.
Ensure large touch targets (min-h-12 or p-4) to remain completely compatible with Mobile and Android TV/Google TV environments.
